name: Classic scissor taper

fade.note: Scissor-over-comb taper at the ears and neck only; no skin.

curly.note: Stay on the longer end of the range so curls can drop.

coily.note: Use a comb and cut dry at 3-4 cm.

growth.note: Neutral; a natural side part conceals mild recession.

density_note: Any; thin hair needs a bit more length on top.
glasses_note: Neat ears and sides leave frames clear.
grow_out: Easy to grow out into a side part.
client: A traditional tidy cut: short around the ears and neck, enough length on top to part and comb. Soft finish.
stylist: Hand-cut the sides with scissor-over-comb from #1-equivalent at the nape to about 2.5 cm; join to top with a vertical channel cut. Edge neckline lightly. Soft taper into natural neck.
prompt_spec: a classic scissor taper: the top 4-7 cm left long enough to part and comb, the sides and back scissor-tapered from about 2.5 cm down to 0.3-1 cm at the nape over the ears and neck only, no skin, a soft natural neckline and tapered mid-ear sideburns

name: Low taper fade

growth.note: Doesn't expose temples; works to stage 4 with a side part or fringe.

density_note: Any; the neat low fade works for fine and thick alike.
glasses_note: Fits any frames; fade is well below the arms.
grow_out: Grows out to scissor taper quickly.

prompt_spec: a low taper fade: the top 4-8 cm with the front at 3-7 cm, combed off a natural or soft side part, the sides and back blended from #0.5 up to #3 (6 mm) starting just above the ear and nape, a tapered neckline and lined sideburns

name: Taper with defined curls

fade.note: Low taper that shortens only the sideburns, ears and nape; the curl mass stays intact above.

straight.note: Straight hair will not hold curl definition; choose a textured crop.

wavy.note: Loose waves form soft curls at 7+ cm; use cream and a diffuser.

curly.note: Core design: cut dry so curl spring is visible.

coily.note: Works at 5-7 cm with twist-out or sponge definition; moisturise.

low.note: Use a volumising curl product and keep the top at the shorter end.

growth.whorl_note: A crown whorl makes curls swirl; leave 1 cm extra length there.
growth.note: Curl volume sits forward and can cover stage 3-4 temples; keep length on the front and avoid a hard line-up.

density_note: Medium to thick works best; fine, low-density curls look flat without volume product.
glasses_note: Tapered sides leave the arms clear; curls above the ear can lift frames, so thin the area.
grow_out: Moves to a curly flow in 8-10 weeks.
client: Short around the ears and neck while the top keeps its natural curls. Defined and easy to maintain.
stylist: Cut the top dry curl-by-curl, leaving 5-9 cm; clipper taper with #1-#3 at the sides. Avoid razor on tight curls; blend the outline with scissors. Soft taper into a natural or lightly rounded neckline.
prompt_spec: a taper with defined curls: natural defined curls of 5-9 cm left intact on top with the front at 4-7 cm, the sides and back tapered low from #3 (10 mm) to #0.5, shortening only the sideburns, ears and nape (#1 at the nape), a soft tapered neckline
